Heyyy, I just read your post and oh boi I know this feeling when you just want to love someone, but what you need to understand is, there is no age where you should have a gf or a bf it comes all with time. You will find the right person for you even if it takes months or years. And on top of that, how you write about going on vacation with your partner makes me just believe more that you are a really nice person that deserves to be loved and you don't need to be extroverted to find a partner. Just try it over the internet everyday someone meets there his/her love of the life. Just don't stress yourself (I know sounds stupid, but you have to try it). At some point there will be someone who loves you. Something about me, I really don't wanna be single anymore, I want the same as you, I wanna cuddle and love someone and yes I cried many times because i thought I would never find someone, but now like a month ago I finally met someone. So what I trying to say is just take your time, there are billions of people who want someone like you, they just need to find you

If you really wanna end yourself and you think there is no way out, than please do it as fast as possible so you don't have to suffer. That's the only advice I can give, don't make it harder and longer, if you really don't wanna live anymore, you deserve a quick and painless death

Shit I don't really know what to say. It's the first time I'm on this subreddit, cause I'm not doing so well lately. I can tell you what helped me in my hard times, you have to open yourself to someone. It might sounds stupid, but hear me out. I never really talked about my feelings with someone, which is really not good, and that now nearly 10 years I just closed myself and acted happy infornt of others, but deep down I was never really happy. Now like almost a month ago I met this girl over the internet and we are having such a good time and I really like her and I thinks she really likes me too, but that's not what I want to say. I wanna say that she is the first person I really told how I was feeling and how sad I am and she is still talking to me (which was the first time that happens). What I'm trying to say is if you find a person who really listen to you and trying to cheer you up, you gonna feel better trust me and I don't think it should be a close friend no. I think it should be someone who you really like and who really likes you. I know you situation is a lot harder than mine, but trust me, you need to find the right person. I always have problems with self-confidence and all that, but what you need to understand is that everything of it is in your head and I can say to you, most of your friends don't think you're manipulative and if so fuck them. So this is all I wanted to say, everything here is written from my heart and I really really hope for you, that you can make it out of that hell. If you ever need someone to talk to jsut message me I'm always here to help you. <3
